name: Arathi Basin Mark of Honor!
label: Quest
description: Arathi Basin Mark of Honor!: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: War must be fought with soldiers, any soldier will tell you. They'll also say that a battle fought with poor gear or on an empty stomach is lost before it starts!
That is why Arathi Basin is important. There are key areas in the basin that hold essential resources. Metals, weapons, food, lumber - all are needed, and all can be gained there.
That is what I want from you, friend. Enter Arathi Basin, win the battle by holding more bases than the enemy, and return to me with a Mark of Honor.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Do you have the Marks of Honor, friend? The League of Arathor can't fight a decent battle without them...

clips.title: Completion
paras: You got the Mark! Great job! I'll send the ressources to our quartermasters, who can quickly disperse them to our troops.
Thank you, friend. Indeed, performing successful missions like the one you achieved are how wars are truly won.
